svg.aria-label: Bytes queued in the sender's own qdisc for one Reno flow at 10 Mbit/s: megabytes when netem orphans the skb, kilobytes when TSQ can see it
svg.text: netem frees each skb at enqueue, so TSQ never sees this queue
netem on s0: socket charge dropped at enqueue
